_comment: The Fake Rares 5th birthday, as a timeline. Times are HH:MM in event.timezone on event.date. Every fact below was checked against the card index (src/data/fullCardIndex.ts) - keep it that way. Placeholders: {SCRILLA} {N} {RATE} {LEADERBOARD} {ASSET} {SERIES} {CARD} {ARTIST} {SUPPLY} {ISSUANCE} {QUESTION} {ANSWER} {EXPLANATION} {TOP} {K} {TOTAL}. Posts are plain text: no markdown, no HTML. The file is re-read when it changes, so an edit on the droplet takes effect on the next tick without a restart.

history_drops.text: 🎂 Five years ago, Series 1 dropped. 50 cards, 41 artists, and this at #1: FAKEASF. Community made, 1,030 of them. Everything since started here.
🔥 Series 1, card #2. FAKETORCH. Supply: ONE. Five years on it is still the only card in the collection with a supply of one. Somebody in this room is holding it.
🕯 Before there was a Series 1, there was Series 0. FREEDOMKEK: {SCRILLA}, October 2017, 298 of them. Series 0, card #1. The one the rest of us have been chasing ever since.

📊 Five years, by the numbers:

18 series.
893 cards.
412 artists.

Series 3 alone: 50 cards by 50 different artists. Not one repeat.

🖼 Series 18 is the newest, 41 cards and counting. One of them is me. PEPEDAWN, Series 18 #22, by rabbidfly, 133 of us. I half suspect I hatched from a FREEDOMKEK dispenser. Nobody has confirmed or denied it.

start.text:
🎉 It's the day. Fake Rares turns FIVE.

House rule for the next 24 hours: every time somebody says {SCRILLA}'s name in here, I count it. Updates through the day. Go.

updates.text: 📣 {SCRILLA} count so far: {N}. That is {RATE} an hour. Pathetic, or impressive. I have not decided.
📣 {SCRILLA} count: {N}, running at {RATE} an hour. The man cannot escape his own channel.

final.text: 🏁 Final {SCRILLA} count for the fifth birthday: {N}. {RATE} an hour, all day. A number nobody asked for and nobody will forget.
